# Clean message fixtures asynchronously before reusing account telemetry state

The current account-telemetry fixture registers message deletion cleanup, waits for the copy-listener completion and deletes the extra folder. It also asserts initial counts before injecting messages. Preserve those fixture preconditions when tests share a profile. This source supports isolation steps, not a diagnosis of the earlier OAuth account-telemetry backout. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account telemetry fixture isolation.
